note: One entry per immutable iteration. Entries are append-only: a published directory is never edited, and a superseded entry keeps its link so a figure quoted from it can still be found.

iterations.title: Electrification Workbench
iterations.feature: The paper's five relations, live: average power, peak at a stated load factor, load factor measured from a published peak, nameplate at a capacity factor, and displaced fuel converted through useful output.

iterations.title: Firm Capacity Workbench
iterations.feature: N-1 firm capacity for a transformer bank, apparent power from a stated power factor, and a demand assessed against firm rather than installed capacity. Exposes the gap where most connection refusals actually live.
